scope: One retained desktop viewport showing an existing completed FourField TUTORIAL1 result; screenshot review is separate from HTTP/numerical verification.

observations.method: live browser observation reported to reviewer
observations.observation: Model picker verified in the hosted application; the existing FourField results view and its plotted output were captured.
observations.limit: No claim that every dropdown choice or history action was exercised.

observations.observation: Four-field model selector, collapsed Saved runs control, OpenSTREAM logo, Log out control, Inputs/Results tabs and Reference inputs badge are visible.
The completed result displays Converged, Archived profiles agree and Informational diagnostics in separate panels.

Axial-profile controls show Physical result, Mass flow rate and Final · t = 0 s; the chart has a Mass flow rate (kg/s) vertical-axis label and plotted curves. Save PNG, Check and Run controls are visible.
The supplied desktop viewport has readable, separate model/status/chart controls; the page continues below the captured viewport.

limitations: One desktop viewport only; mobile layouts, every plot selection and every control interaction were not verified by this screenshot.
The full lower chart, horizontal-axis label and legend are outside the captured viewport; no complete-figure layout assertion is made.
Visible buttons do not establish that their actions were exercised; HTTP authentication, cancellation and downloads are evidenced separately.
A screenshot is not numerical verification, experimental validation or proof of complete MATLAB parity.

ci.source: coordinating operator verified provider result; separate CI receipt owns exact job details
